policy_decision.rule: s1_dualpol_valid_v2 pixel observed iff VV source mask present AND VH source mask present AND finite(VV) AND finite(VH) AND VV > -70 dB AND VH > -70 dB
policy_decision.semantics: OBSERVATION_VALIDITY_RULE_ONLY: <= -70 dB is classified NON_OBSERVATION_EXTREME_FLOOR; not a claim that all values below -70 dB are physically impossible
policy_decision.raw_raster_policy: RAW GEE VALUES PRESERVED EXACTLY; no clipping, no replacement, no rewrite; mask is derived
policy_decision.threshold_origin: owner decision 2026-10-09; provisional conservative value in the empirical gap between normal bulk minima and the discrete GEE frame-border floor
